title.narrative: SUCCESS: Support to the CSO Council and Ethiopian Civil Society Sector (ECSOC)

description.narrative: The project is designed to achieve the overall objective of contributing to the realization of a proactive, credible, and vibrant Civil Society sector that assume a central role in the political, economic and social transformation of the country. The design was made to 1) strengthen the Capacity of Ethiopian Civil Society Council and its members and their networks, and 2) to enhance the representation and coordination of CSO sector in Ethiopia.
